title: World Championships Canoe Marathon in Brandenburg 16.09.2016 to 18.09.2016
note: Organiser results workbook (single sheet, one row per paddler: Rank / Boat / ID / SURNAME, Given (YOB) / Nation / Diff / Time). STARTING_LANE = printed boat number (Gyor_2025_MAR precedent); ID is the event bib, not an ICF id. Prints the scheduled race start to the minute (written HH:MM:00); no actual start clock on any finite source. No ICF ids printed: seats name-bound (bind_seat + PWW profile rule). OQ/para races in the same book are kept (one key).
